title: Michael Carrick rages at 'one of the worst decisions I've ever seen' as 10-man Man Utd suffer home defeat to Leeds
desc: Michael Carrick was left incensed by officiating standards after Manchester United fell to a home defeat against Leeds at Old Trafford. The manager hit out at a "shocking" VAR intervention that saw Lisandro Martinez sent off, marking a significant setback for his side in their quest for a top-four Premier League finish.

title: US says ball in Iran's court as push grows to end war
desc: The United States has said that "the ball is in the Iranian court" on ending the Middle East war, as diplomats have accelerated efforts towards a new round of peace talks after weekend negotiations failed to produce a deal.
